correctness.rationale: In characteristic two F=U²A+UVB+V²C is geometrically smooth exactly when B is nonzero and gcd(B,(CA′+AC′)²+AC(B′)²)=1 in both base charts. Elimination of the quadratic fibre coordinate accounts for all geometric singularities; direct evaluation of three rational fibres counts N, and Deuring–Shafarevich computes p-rank as distinct geometric zeros of homogeneous B minus one (infinity counted once). The 36 coordinate changes preserve the embedded problem. A separate complete 32,767-section scan verified exactly 9,216 smooth, all 17 nonzero distribution cells, 294 orbits, and the six-point split of 282/801 equations in 11/26 orbits. This exhaustive finite calculation is within the precisely specified F2 coefficient domain.
residual_risks: Finite classification is F2 only and does not classify abstract F2 isomorphism classes.
